messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick postmortem follow-up from the partial-response incident earlier today. TL;DR: transient gateway timeouts + aggressive client reconnects caused duplicate sessions and dropped KV cache hits.
eli park: Thanks — can you drop the root cause hypothesis here and the proposed owners for each action?
anika singh: short version: load spike hit a path with a stale keepalive config, conn idle closed mid-stream. client retried immediately, triggered reconnect storm.
moses-bot: (automated) Incident incident-2829 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4829 :file_folder:
maria gonzalez: Action items I propose: 1) server: extend idle TCP keepalive to 90s for chat-proxy (owner: eli, due EOD+2). 2) client: add jittered exponential backoff on reconnects (owner: devon, due EOD+5). 3) observability: add a partial-response alert when stream sends >1 reconnect within 5s (owner: anika, due EOD+3). 4) rollout: canary keepalive change 10% traffic, monitor error ratio (owner: sophia, due tomorrow).
devon r.: ack on client backoff. I’ll add a small lib change: default backoff = 200ms * 2^n + jitter(0-150ms), cap 10s. Will send PR by EOD today.
eli park: for the server change I’ll validate kernel tcp_keepalive_time tweaks and add a config flag in chat-proxy. Will coordinate the canary with sophia.
sophia: I’ll handle the canary and dashboard. Adding a short dashboard with: error_rate, reconnect_rate, partial_response_count, kv_cache_hit_rate. Will post dashboard link when ready.
anika singh: For alerts, suggest this rule: alert if partial_response_count > 5 AND avg_reconnect_rate > 3/min over 5m. Also tag incidents by client library version to catch regressions.
maria gonzalez: Good. Also adding long-term: evaluate client-side resume protocol vs full reconnect; spike on memory / KV-cache invalidation. Owner: tyler, due next sprint.
tyler: I’ll scope resume protocol experiment and write a doc with tradeoffs by end of sprint.
eli park: Quick note — ops-bot will create subtasks under INF-4829 automatically once PRs referenced. devon, please reference the ticket in your PR.
ops-bot: Created subtasks: INF-4829-1 (server keepalive), INF-4829-2 (client backoff), INF-4829-3 (alerts + dashboard), INF-4829-4 (canary rollout).
devon r.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/chat-client/pull/712 — references INF-4829-2.
sophia: Canary started at 10:15 UTC on 2829991200; monitoring now. :eyes:
maria gonzalez: Monitoring note: partial_response_count fell from 28 -> 4 in the canary cohort after backoff/config changes. Still observing a handful of sessions showing rapid double reconnects; tracking separately.
eli park: Next check-in tomorrow 09:30 for canary review and decision to roll to 50%. If stable we roll next day.
anika singh: I’ll add one more check: record a sample of client reconnect sequence numbers to help replay root cases.
maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone — adding these notes to the incident doc and closing the postmortem follow-up thread. If you pick up any blockers ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
